title: Export
summary: Official Derivative reference for exporting CHOP channels or DAT data to operator parameters, covering CHOP exporting, DAT exporting, Export Flag behavior, mass-export channel naming, DAT text/path support, and expression-reference tradeoffs.
guidance: Use this article when planning a CHOP or DAT control signal that should override operator parameters.
CHOP exports drive number values, flags, and menus; DAT exports also support text strings and path-style parameters such as Text TOP text or Select TOP paths.
For mass-export workflows, channel names can use the documented path:parameter shape when the CHOP Export Method is Channel Name is Path:Parameter.
Export links depend on channel names and order, so stabilize exported control networks with named Null CHOPs before wiring them into parameters.
Expressions can add inline math and are often easier across component boundaries, while exports are useful for bulk parameter driving.
The Export Flag controls whether a CHOP's exporting is active, so generated plans should not assume an export works just because the mapping exists.
